title: Lottie
summary: Thin-line vector accents in the theme style, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs: white hairlines on a see-through ground with one poppy dot — marks that draw on, frames that open, and small cues that count, pulse or point. No fills, nothing bounces.
usage: {"piece": "lottie/hairline-underline"}. Transparent, so they sit on footage or on any dark card. Files: library/themes/fashion/lottie/animations/.

items.name: Hairline underline
items.description: A hairline opening from its middle with a poppy dot at its end and a short line of small print under it.

items.name: Ring draw
items.description: A thin ring drawing round from a poppy dot, a fainter ring following inside it.

items.name: Registration mark
items.description: A printer’s cross-hair: two hairlines opening through a small ring, faint corner ticks and a poppy centre.

items.name: Arrow draw
items.description: A long hairline arrow drawing left to right from a poppy dot, its head opening at the end.

items.name: Plus to check
items.description: A plus inside a faint ring that folds into a tick, finished with a poppy dot.

items.name: Corner ticks
items.description: Four corner ticks opening outwards into a frame around a tiny centre cross and poppy dot: marks a subject.

items.name: Panels open
items.description: Three tall panel outlines of unequal width drawing on and sliding into a row: the theme’s vertical-panel motif.

items.name: Scan line
items.description: A hairline with a poppy dot sweeping slowly down inside faint corner ticks (loop).

items.name: Count dots
items.description: Three small rings drawn one after another as a poppy dot steps through them: one, two, three.

items.name: Dot pulse
items.description: A poppy dot giving one soft pulse, a thin ring widening and fading away (loop).

items.name: Dashed ring
items.description: A ring of fine dashes turning very slowly around a thin ring with a poppy dot travelling it (loop).

items.name: Swipe up
items.description: Three chevrons lighting upwards in turn over a poppy dot (loop).
